metadata.case_name: MA KWAI LAN v. CHIU YUN YAU AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: cleaning worker at Hong Lok Yuen

injuries.description: head injury with loss of consciousness and amnesia
source: head injury with loss of consciousness and amnesia
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with loss of consciousness, duration unspecified or unknown due to lack of information

source: oblique and unsightly sunken scar over her left right cheek or left cheek should be right from the laceration
the deep wound sustained by the Plaintiff on her right cheek
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: neck perispinal muscle spasm with decreased range of movement, otherwise described as neck sprain and contusion
source: neck perispinal muscle spasm with decreased range of movement, otherwise described as neck sprain and contusion
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain with musculoskeletal signs

injuries.description: 2-cm hyper-dense area at the upper pole of the right kidney consistent with intra-renal haematoma (right renal haematoma / partial loss of renal tissue)
source: CT scan of the abdominal area revealed a 2-cm hyper-dense area at the upper pole of the right kidney consistent with intra-renal haematoma
the right renal haematoma resulted from the accident has not resolved completely

injuries.description: soft tissue injury / contusion of the left shoulder with restricted motion
source: she is unable to elevate her left arm to overhead level mainly because of shoulder pain
soft tissue around the left shoulder was also injured during the accident
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: left knee contusion and abrasion with subsequent pain and patello-femoral joint degeneration made symptomatic and disuse atrophy of left thigh and calf
source: On examination, crepitus were detected over both patello-femoral joints... only the left knee, which was the injured side, was painful and tender
there were some wasting of the left thigh and calf muscles, suggesting the Plaintiff was unable to use her left lower limb in a normal way, a condition known as disused atrophy
injuries.icd_description: Multiple superficial injuries of lower leg

manifestations.description: conspicuous/unsightly scar over right cheek with pain
saliva would escape whenever she spoke and ate (drooling) and difficulty in speaking and chewing
neck pain over the left side with decreased range of movement; pain radiating to left side of head, face and left upper limb
unable to elevate left arm to overhead level due to shoulder pain; restricted shoulder motion
left knee pain after walking for a long distance often associated with left calf muscle cramps
difficulty in climbing stairs, slopes and squatting
residual left side chest wall pain, especially when lifting heavy objects
wasting of left thigh and calf muscles (disuse atrophy)
unable to sleep on her left side

treatments_future: specialist consultation with urine analysis and CT scan once a year
plastic surgery consultation (recommended by Dr Choi but not undertaken)

losses.description: Unsightly and conspicuous scar over right cheek causing discomfort and affecting appearance
Difficulty in speaking and chewing; saliva escaping when speaking and eating
Difficulty climbing stairs and reliance on handrails to climb stairs
Feeling she required to be looked after constantly instead of looking after her husband and son
No longer goes out after work and reduced sociability

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy food and drink
losses.description: Affected food ingestion due to cheek injury
Required to be looked after rather than looking after husband and son
